thread:
maria_cs: FYI SilverLark hit a bunch of 504s from EU during their investor demo at 08:45 UTC. Theyre asking for a short EU edge + transient rate increase to cover the demo window. Renewal touchpoint in ~2w, potential churn if demo looks flaky.

devon_se: Any metrics? which endpoints?

maria_cs: Mostly /v1/chat and /v1/generate. They saw sustained ~90rps for 8m with short spikes to ~220rps. Errors appear to be proxy timeouts in eu cluster. Customer asked for "eu-edge + 1.8x qps" for 36h starting today 11:00 UTC.

leena_netops: We can do eu-north-1-edge on short notice and add their IPs to the allowlist. Need CIDRs and exact window. Recommend TTL 36h auto-revoke so its not permanent.

maria_cs: CIDRs sent: 51.15.200.0/22, 203.0.113.64/27. They want start at 11:00 UTC and end 23:00 UTC + next day (36h).

leena_netops: OK i'll create ACL entry "silverlark-demo-5066" and apply to eu-north-1-edge. Will set rule id acl-9922.

devon_se: For safety, set a per-route QPS override on their api token route instead of global account quota. I can push a route override of x1.8 and also pin them to the burst node pool.

sam_infra: Ill spin up a small burst node group in eu-north-1 (2 x A10g equiv) and tag it for "silverlark-burst-5066". Auto-scale disabled for demo window. I'll open INC-4400 and tag eng-sre for monitoring.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-4400 "SilverLark EU demo: edge allowlist + route qps override" by sam_infra. ETA: 70m.

maria_cs: Please add a renewal note: customer said if demo fails theyll escalate pricing conversation. Set renewal_risk: medium-high.

leena_netops: ACL applied to eu-north-1-edge. rule acl-9922. Please verify with customer tests.

maria_cs: Sent test window and curl example to their ops team. Theyll run tests at 11:05 UTC.

maria_cs: curl sample:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SILVER_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"gptx-latency","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"test"}]}'
```

devon_se: Ill watch traces + tail error rates for the route. If latency/rate limit errors persist we have a fallback to hosted-eu-replica and can throttle bursts.

sam_infra: Burst nodes provisioned, qps override pushed, auto-revoke scheduled at +36h. :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: Thanks team. Ill collect post-demo feedback and add details to the renewal playbook entry. :memo:
